title: I Let the Train-Gate Scanner Catch the Shoulder-Tap They Called Family

parts.text: I scanned one ticket and a stranger tapped my shoulder like we were related. The gate sign said: ONE BEEP, ONE BODY. I was thirty-seven, commuter, holding a coffee. Agent Wes waved them. "Families bunch." I was not family. I let the scanner catch the second body without a beep and asked the supervisor to look at the light. Wes stamped a second ticket after the fact. The stranger paid. I drank coffee that finally had a seat. Bunching, it turns out, beeps twice.

social.video_title: They shoulder-tapped through a one-beep train gate — Part 1/1
social.description: One ticket, a stranger tap, families bunch. The supervisor watched the light. Would you have pretended a cousin?
